answer: Oasis admission with a pearl audit: a new identity enters a trial oasis where three randomly assigned established auditors independently verify its real work over one week, checking that its claimed relic credentials are genuine and not copied across puppets. Auditors stake their own reputation on each approval and lose it if a later audit exposes a sybil, so approving a fake costs them dearly. A farmer must pass three unpredictable, independent audits per puppet, and cannot pre-bribe auditors it cannot identify in advance, making bulk forgery slow, expensive, and likely to be exposed.
